channel.title: Havok Restoration of Central PA Blog
channel.description: Restoration, insurance and home safety advice for Central Pennsylvania homeowners.

item.title: Water Damage in Your Johnstown Home: The First 24 Hours, Step by Step
item.description: A pipe burst, a water heater failed, or a storm pushed water in. Exactly what to do in the first 24 hours to protect your home, family and insurance claim.

item.title: Does Homeowners Insurance Cover Water Damage in Pennsylvania? What Is Covered, What Is Not
item.description: Burst pipes, sewer backups, floods, ice dams, mold. A plain-English guide to what a Pennsylvania homeowners policy covers after water damage and what it excludes.

item.title: Your Insurance Company Recommended a Contractor. Do You Have to Use Them? (Pennsylvania)
item.description: Pennsylvania homeowners can choose their own restoration contractor. How carrier vendor programs work, questions to ask, and red flags to avoid.

item.title: After a House Fire: What to Do in the First 48 Hours
item.description: The fire is out. Now what? A calm checklist for Central PA families: safety, insurance, securing the home, salvaging belongings, and what restoration involves.

item.title: Why Basements Flood in Johnstown and the Conemaugh Valley (and What Actually Fixes It)
item.description: Sump failure, seepage, sewer backup or surface water? The four ways Johnstown basements flood, how to tell which you have, and the fixes that work here.

item.title: How Fast Does Mold Grow After Water Damage? (Faster Than You Think)
item.description: Mold can colonize wet drywall within 24 to 48 hours. The timeline, where it hides after a leak, when you need remediation, and what PA insurance covers.

item.title: Sewage Backup in Your Basement: Why It Is a Biohazard and How Cleanup Actually Works
item.description: A sewer backup is Category 3 contaminated water, not just a wet basement. Why it is dangerous, what to do now, what must be discarded, and how cleanup works.

item.title: How to Help a Loved One Whose Home Has Become a Hoarding Situation
item.description: A compassionate guide for Central PA families: starting the conversation, when it becomes a safety issue, and what a respectful professional cleanout involves.

item.title: Ice Dams in Central Pennsylvania: Why Your Ceiling Is Leaking in February and How to Stop It
item.description: Ice dams cause thousands in interior water damage across the Laurel Highlands every winter. What causes them, warning signs, what to do now, and how to prevent them.

item.title: Frozen and Burst Pipes in Central PA: How to Prevent Them, and What to Do When One Lets Go
item.description: Sub-zero nights freeze pipes across Cambria, Blair and Somerset counties every winter. Where they freeze, how to prevent it, and what to do when one bursts.
